We wrote about our thoughtful communication and our remote culture; give it a read.

    To drive it home, here's a recent calendar of an engineer who has been with us for over a year:

  • Small, temporary teams. A designer and two engineers. A backend engineer and a CS person. The group forms around the problem, ships, and dissolves. No standing squads, no permanent team structures — at least not yet. The people closest to the problem usually shape the solution.

Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!

Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.

We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.

It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

Kraken Generation Flex
The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves to be at the heart of that change.

Our aim is to be the leading global provider of solutions that enable customers to release £30bn of value per annum from distributed energy resources (DERs). We are building a Software as a Service (SaaS) subscription business with a global addressable market of £2.4 billion per annum, by digitally connecting hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets.

We have already attained a market leading position and Kraken is a recognised thought leader and innovator in the industry.

🏠 Where you'll fit in:

As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and growth, we're looking for a Generation Flex Delivery Manager to own the successful onboarding of flexible generation and energy assets onto KrakenFlex across the EU with a focus on Germany.

This is a customer-facing delivery role with a strong technical bias. You'll manage an asset through the full onboarding journey, from initial discovery and technical analysis, through site design and gateway installation, to commissioning, testing and handover into live service.

You'll sit at the intersection of our customers, Electrical Engineering, Product and Customer Success Engineering teams. You'll need to understand both the connectivity and control architecture of our customers' assets and how those assets connect to and operate through the KrakenFlex SaaS platform.

You won't be expected to design the details of the integration solution or write the software yourself. Instead, you'll need enough technical depth across both areas to understand how they fit together, identify gaps and risks, challenge incomplete information and drive the right conversations to get a site successfully integrated.

Your role is to bring together three perspectives throughout onboarding:

Customer: What is the customer trying to achieve, and what do we need from them?

Product: How will the asset operate within KrakenFlex, and what product capabilities and configuration are required?

Engineering: How does the physical asset need to be integrated, connected and commissioned to make that solution work?

Your job is to make sure those three come together as one successfully delivered customer solution.

  • Work closely with Product and Software Engineering teams to understand the relevant GenFlex capabilities, product modules, configuration requirements and technical constraints for each customer and asset.

  • Translate between customer requirements, electrical engineering requirements and SaaS/product requirements, making sure each group understands what is needed from the others.

  • Understand the end-to-end data and control path from the physical asset through site controls, meters, PPCs, gateways and communications infrastructure into Kraken Flex, and from Kraken Flex back to the asset where control is required.

  • Ensure that the customer's intended use of the GenFlex product is reflected in the technical onboarding solution, including the required telemetry, controls, configuration, integrations and product modules.

  • Be able to explain to customers how their site will interact with KrakenFlex, both from a physical integration perspective and from a software/product perspective.

  • Work with Product teams to identify where customer or asset requirements do not fit current product capabilities, and ensure gaps, constraints or product dependencies are surfaced early.

  • Feed recurring onboarding challenges, customer requirements and technical integration pain points back into Product and Engineering teams to help improve and scale the GenFlex proposition.

  • Be the primary delivery point of contact for customers during site onboarding, setting clear expectations around what we need from them, what Kraken is delivering and what needs to happen next.

  • Work closely with our Electrical Engineering and Customer Success Engineering teams to ensure the technical information required to integrate a site is complete, accurate and available at the right stage of delivery.

  • Review and interpret customer technical documentation including:

    • Electrical Single Line Diagrams (SLDs)

    • Network and communications diagrams

    • Site and asset specifications

    • PPC and controller documentation

    • Modbus register maps

    • IP addressing and network information

    • Functional Design Specifications

    • Metering and telemetry information

    • Hardware and connectivity requirements

  • Be confident discussing technical site architecture with customers and engineers, understanding how equipment such as generators, batteries, meters, PPCs, controllers, gateways and site networks fit together.

  • Identify missing, inconsistent or technically unclear customer information early and drive it to resolution before it becomes a delivery blocker.

  • Coordinate the preparation and review of Kraken integration documentation, including gateway architecture, communications diagrams, Kraken SLDs, integration designs and site configuration information.

  • Coordinate the Kraken Gateway delivery and installation process, ensuring prerequisites such as power, networking, connectivity and installation arrangements are understood and ready.

  • Manage readiness for key commissioning and testing activities, including:

    • Gateway installation and connectivity

    • Operational acceptance testing

    • Kraken market and service testing

  • Proactively manage delivery risks and communicate issues and mitigation plans clearly to internal and external stakeholders.

  • Surface blockers early and drive the right people together to resolve them rather than allowing issues to sit between teams.

  • Maintain clear visibility of the status and health of each site, including technical readiness, product readiness, customer actions, Kraken actions and upcoming milestones.

  • Continuously improve the Generation Flex onboarding process, identifying recurring technical, product or customer blockers and working with Engineering, Product and Operations teams to remove them.

🧠 What you'll bring to the party:

  • A strong technical background and the confidence to work closely with electrical, control systems, and networking.

  • A practical understanding of industrial networking and communications, including concepts such as IP addressing, LANs, routers, switches, VPNs and site connectivity.

  • Enough electrical engineering knowledge to understand concepts such as metering, breakers, transformers, generators, inverters, batteries and asset control systems.

  • Experience delivering technical projects involving the integration, commissioning or onboarding of physical assets, ideally within energy, renewables, utilities, industrial automation, controls or a similar environment.

  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to take a complicated technical problem and clearly explain the issue, impact, owner and next action.

  • Experience coordinating multiple teams and dependencies across customers, Electrical Engineering, hardware, installation partners and other third parties.

  • A highly organised approach to delivery, with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple sites at different stages of onboarding simultaneously.

  • The ability to proactively identify risk, remove blockers and maintain momentum in an environment where customer readiness and site timelines can change quickly.

  • A customer-centric mindset and a drive to provide an outstanding onboarding experience without compromising technical quality.

  • A pragmatic, collaborative approach and the confidence to operate in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are still evolving.

  • A strong interest in understanding how a SaaS product works end-to-end, rather than treating the software platform as a black box.

  • A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment, comfortable navigating the complexity and comfortable being the regional face of site onboarding function.

  • Language: professional fluency in German and English

⭐ Bonus points

  • Experience in APIs, data flows, system integrations or cloud software architecture would be beneficial.

  • Experience in flexible generation, battery storage, renewable energy, demand response or distributed energy resources.

  • A working understanding of industrial communication protocols and controlled environments would be helpful (e.g. modbus, OPC UA

  • Previous experience working with grid-connected assets, control systems or energy market services.

  • Experience with SaaS implementation, technical product onboarding or systems integration.

  • Familiarity with commissioning processes and the distinction between cold commissioning, energisation and hot commissioning.

  • Experience with industrial gateways, edge devices or IoT connectivity.

About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronization, and multi-chip scaling.
  • You build excellent software. You've owned substantial systems from design through production. You're strong in Python and/or at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or C, and rigorous about interfaces, abstractions, and testing. We care about engineering quality more than a specific language.
  • You understand LLM inference end to end. You can read a new model's implementation and reason about prefill, decode, attention variants, KV caches, MoE, and parallelism, and how they map to compute, memory, and communication.
  • You build with agents. Agentic development is how you work, not an experiment. You'd rather build the loop that finds the optimization than find it by hand, and you know when the loop still needs a human.
  • You build things others succeed with. You've designed APIs, libraries, or performance tooling that other engineers adopted.
  • You drive problems to resolution. You form clear hypotheses, measure, and follow the evidence across software and hardware boundaries. You take ownership of the result.

If you hit a few of those boxes, we'd like to speak to you.

  • Experience with embedded, bare-metal, or low-level runtime programming.

Your code will decide how fast models run on our hardware, and how easy it is for the next engineer, or the next agent, to make them faster. ScorePlay is the AI-powered media infrastructure for sports, built to automate the content operations behind the world’s biggest sports organizations. 💡 Overview

As our People Ops Intern, you'll work at the heart of the People team, supporting both People Operations and Talent Acquisition. Early-stage development starts with a chain of high-stakes decisions, each requiring different data, different expertise, and different deliverables. Today, we deliver AI-powered outputs across the full spectrum - site sourcing, feasibility studies, architectural design, investment analysis, financial modeling, dataroom analysis, and more.

The Role

You will work on one of the core systems behind what Davis delivers. Our agents take raw, fragmented data and turn it into deliverables that real estate professionals use to make high-stakes decisions. Your job is to make that pipeline reliable, fast, and indistinguishable from work done by the best human teams - then push it beyond what any human team could do.

You can expect to:

  • Build and operate multi-agent systems that turn heterogeneous data into expert-grade deliverables across real estate development workflows.

  • Own the system end to end: infra, orchestration, context engineering, how the system selects, structures, and injects the right information so agents behave reliably at scale.

  • 1.5+ years building and deploying production software at scale (APIs, reliability, testing, performance).

  • Experience building and evaluating LLM agents / multi-step workflows in real systems.

  • Strong experience with databases + data modeling (structured storage, document storage, versioning).

Nice to Have

  • GIS familiarity (parcels, zoning layers, geocoding).

  • Multi-country product experience (heterogeneous sources, localization, varying rules).

  • NLP background

  • Direct impact on growth: your work doesn't sit behind three layers of review. You ship, clients use it, and you see the results. Every output you improve translates directly into revenue and reputation.

  • Real-world impact: your work supports investment decisions, accelerates development timelines, and helps redefine how cities are imagined, designed, and built.

  • High ownership: own the full feasibility stack end to end, as the CEO of that part.

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He's a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we're a team of 12: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise.

We're small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you're the one we need.

Why We'll Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It didn't work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We don't sell tools, we sell the work: AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design Yet

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability; parametric tools only check constraints after generation, leading to designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but doesn't yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. As a result, floorplans may “look” plausible but break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they're usable.

It spans three complementary dimensions: guaranteeing the quality and architectural credibility of our deliverables, now generated in hours; co-producing the architectural plans that go with them; and actively contributing to the development of our plan-generation technology. It is an architect role whose impact reaches well beyond your own output.

You will run a portfolio of residential projects, under the supervision of a lead architect, from feasibility through to schematic design.

The core of the role

  • Read the local planning documents (zoning plans, development-orientation schemes, easements) and derive the project assumptions from them.

  • Develop massing, circulation principles and capacity scenarios consistent with the regulatory framework.

  • Certify the architectural credibility of what the pipeline produces, confirming that each plan is sound and setting out the reasoning behind it.

  • Develop the project phase after phase, from a first capacity scenario through to a resolved project at schematic design.

  • Produce the graphic documents (plans, images, diagrams) that make the project clear and compelling.

  • Arbitrate between scenarios against programmatic, regulatory and economic constraints.

Contribute to the technology

  • Formalize best practice, translating what a strong residential plan respects into criteria our AI teams can use.

  • Qualify the model's outputs, defining the standard a strong plan meets and validating each result against it, with the reasoning.

  • Work across the product, tech and real estate teams, inside the tool's continuous-improvement cycles.

Work as a team

  • Take part in project reviews and exchange with the other architects to improve the methods and the quality of the deliverables.

  • Contribute to the team's graphic standards.

Who We Are Looking For

  • Education: a degree in architecture.

  • Experience: around 3 to 4 years in an agency, ideally one specialized in residential work. You have a real command of the residential floor plan and can, from a site and a brief, produce credible, well-drawn capacity scenarios.

  • Appetite for digital tools and AI: you do not need to code, but the drive to fold these tools into your practice and push it forward is essential.

Domain skills

  • Command of the residential floor plan, circulation, orientation, building depths, cores, the unit-type mix from studio to four-bedroom, tenure types (market-rate, social, intermediate, and affordable home-ownership).

  • From rule to impact, linking a rule to its concrete effect on a plan or a buildable capacity.

  • Graphic production, images and diagrams that explain the project and make it legible.

    • Meewerken aan leuke interne projecten en verbeterideeën.

    Amsterdam (hybrid) | Part-time (freelance) 8 hours a week | €2,000 to €2,500 per month


    Foleon is a leading content creation platform providing business teams with a fast and scalable way to produce highly-engaging content experiences that bring a new level of intelligence to their customer journeys.

    Foleon is based in Amsterdam and New York and serves more than 1,200 global B2B brands. We value people who are bold, ambitious, collaborative, and customer-centric. Even better, the ones who know how to work hard and have fun at the same time. We’re a team of highly driven people, with a great sense of human connection and a clear focus.

    Your Mission

    As our Senior Product & AI Counsel, you’ll own the legal side of our product and AI proposition, working with us about one day a week on a retainer basis. It’s a new role. You’ll work closely with Product, Engineering and leadership to make sure what we build and ship holds up under the EU AI Act, cybersecurity law, digital accessibility rules and GDPR.

    Your Job

    • Act as our product counsel: join product syncs, review features before they’re built, and flag legal and compliance questions early.

    • Lead compliance for our AI proposition: classify our AI use cases, map our obligations as a provider or deployer under the EU AI Act, and set up the documentation, transparency and governance it requires.

    • Make sure our platform, and the content our customers publish with it, meets the European Accessibility Act and related standards.

    • Build privacy into the product by advising on GDPR questions tied to new features and data.

    • Advise on cybersecurity law, including NIS2, the Cyber Resilience Act and incident reporting duties, working closely with our security team.

    • Track changes in AI, cybersecurity, accessibility and privacy regulation, and turn them into practical guidance for the team.


    Your Competencies & Skills

    • Senior and independent: you make calls and own them, without someone steering you.

    • A practical communicator who explains complex regulation to product teams in plain language, with answers instead of memos full of caveats.

    • Proactive and curious: you spot gaps before they become problems and want to understand how the product actually works.

    • Comfortable working part-time and flexibly, and available when something urgent comes up.

    Your Qualifications

    • A Master’s in Law (or equivalent) and 6+ years of experience, ideally a mix of law firm and in-house at a tech or SaaS company.

    • Hands-on experience as product counsel for software, ideally including AI products.

    • Deep working knowledge of the EU AI Act and how it applies to AI propositions in practice.

    • Experience with cybersecurity law (NIS2, Cyber Resilience Act) and digital accessibility rules (European Accessibility Act).

    • A solid grounding in commercial and corporate law, with working knowledge of employment law.

    • GDPR and privacy expertise is a plus, ideally at DPO level or with a certification such as CIPP/E.

    • Experience working with scale-ups on a retainer or fractional basis is a plus.

    • Fluent English. Dutch is a plus.

    Note: All our hiring is done in-house, so we’re not looking for agency support for this role. Thanks for understanding!

Title: Digital Marketing Specialist

Department: Marketing

Reporting to: AD, Digital and Partner Marketing

Compensation: $58K - $75K USD

Employment: Full Time

Location: USA - Remote

Who we are:

World Education Services (WES) is a non-profit social enterprise that supports the educational, economic, and social inclusion of immigrants, refugees, and international students. For 50 years, WES has set the standard for international academic credential evaluation, supporting millions of people as they seek to achieve their academic and professional goals. Through decades of experience as a leader in global education, WES has developed a wide range of tools to pursue social impact at scale. From evaluating academic credentials to shaping policy, designing programs, and providing philanthropic funding, we partner with a diverse set of organizations, leaders, and networks to uplift individuals and drive systems change. Together with its partners, WES enables people to learn, work, and thrive in new places. For more information about WES, please visit our website at www.WES.org.

About the Opportunity:

The Digital Marketing Specialist plays a critical role in supporting WES’s evolving digital marketing strategy. This position reports to the Associate Direct, Digital and Partner Marketing and focuses on day-to-day execution, reporting, and project management across SEM, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) and AI searchability initiatives. The Digital Marketing Specialist assists with high-impact projects such as webinars, conferences, podcast series, and e-commerce transformation.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage and optimize SEM campaigns across Google Ads and other platforms.
  • Implement SEO best practices for website content and landing pages.
  • Support GEO and AI-driven search optimization strategies to improve global visibility and future-proof WES’s digital presence.
  • Monitor campaign performance, analyze data, and prepare reports with actionable insights.
  • Collaborate with the content team to design and produce digital marketing assets for multiple channels (website, paid ads, social media).
  • Coordinate logistics, asset creation, and post-event reporting for applicant-facing webinars and major conferences.
  • Assist in planning, scheduling, and execution of WES’s new podcast series, ensuring timely delivery and cross-team collaboration.
  • Collaborate with internal teams on e-commerce transformation projects to align marketing strategies with new platform capabilities.
  • Review and help fix Google Tags in Google Tag Manager to ensure accurate tracking and reporting.
  • Executing, scheduling, and monitoring email campaigns to build engagement

Your Experience:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, communications, advertising, business management, or in a related field preferred.
  • At least 2 years' experience as a marketing specialist, or a similar role.
  • Proven SEO experience.
  • Strong understanding of SEM, SEO, GEO, and digital analytics tools (Google Ads, GA4, Tag Manager).
  • Experience in gathering and interpreting customer experience information.
  • Knowledge of online customer engagement platforms and channels.
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills and a client-centered approach.
  • Great organizational and time management abilities with the ability to handle shifting workloads and priorities.
  • Experience reporting up and identifying trends or opportunities for process or improvement.
  • Ability to both think strategically and execute tactically.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Project work demonstrating understanding of digital user experience and technology platforms.
  • Advanced computer proficiency.
  • Proactive, self-starter who is comfortable working in a remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Demonstrates adaptability when it comes to shifting priorities and change.
  • Demonstrate strategic thinking driving campaigns, value propositions and managing multiple projects.
  • Outcome-orientated, quantitative, and qualitative problem-solver; comfortable with ambiguity, displaying superb pattern-recognition abilities.
  • Experienced working in a rapidly evolving, entrepreneurial, technology and service driven, client-focused environment.
  • Action orientated individual, thinking, and leading “out of the box.
  • Strong alignment with WES mission and values and demonstrates a growth mindset

What We Offer:

Joining our team at WES means embarking on a purpose-driven career with a global impact, where you contribute daily to making a tangible difference in the lives of people worldwide. You'll thrive in an employee-centric environment, with access to learning opportunities, pathways for personal and professional development, and recognition of your achievements. Our inclusive, mission-driven culture values employees and focuses on investing in our people through our culture, people framework, and programming while offering the flexibility of remote work options.

  • Work-Life Harmony: We believe that success is all about maintaining balance. Enjoy the freedom of remote work and flexible scheduling, paired with generous time-off policies designed to assist you in maintaining a healthy equilibrium between your personal and professional commitments. Our comprehensive wellness programs and work environment are focused on fostering your well-being.
  • Rewards and Recognition: Your dedication and achievements are the cornerstone of our success. We recognize the importance of valuing your hard work which is why we offer competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and tangible rewards to celebrate your contributions.
  • Professional Growth and Development: We are committed to nurturing growth within our team, recognizing that growth is essential to providing opportunities for career advancement and ongoing professional development. To prioritize your learning and success, we invest in comprehensive training programs and offer tuition reimbursement opportunities. We promote a culture of continuous learning that empowers you to thrive and evolve in your career.
  • Innovation and Impact: Engage in work that directly transforms lives and empowers individuals and communities by expanding access to global educational and professional pathways. Join us in fostering a culture that values innovation, embraces new approaches, and leverages transformation to implement and drive impactful change.
  • Community and Connection: Our team is made up of individuals from different cultures and backgrounds who have varying perspectives and ideas. Our diverse workforce reflects the global community we serve, and we take pride in it. We are committed to fostering a workplace where everyone feels valued, respected, and included. Experience the power of connection by participating in a range of activities, including employee-led resource groups, town halls, collaborative team events, meaningful volunteer opportunities, and initiatives that promote equity, celebrate diversity, and cultivate a strong sense of belonging within our organization.

Values:

  • Opportunity - We open doors so people can build better futures.
  • Inclusion - We become stronger, more creative, and more resilient when we embrace diversity.
  • Equity - We uphold fairness and justice in our work and actions.
  • Enterprising - We are resourceful, inventive, and driven.
  • Expertise - We challenge ourselves to be the best at what we do.

Inclusive Recruitment Process:

We welcome all applicants, irrespective of their experience perfectly fitting the job description, as we value diverse and innovative viewpoints. At our organization, individuals who thrive in a culture of continuous learning and inclusive teamwork excel. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and supported and welcome members of all backgrounds and perspectives to apply.

Our Commitment:

At World Education Services, we're committed to fostering an inclusive workplace that reflects the rich tapestry of our communities, both in the US and Canada. This commitment is underscored by our unwavering dedication to providing equal opportunities to all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or genetics. Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project.   3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

WHY DEPT®?

We are a Growth Invention company built to help the world’s most ambitious brands grow faster. Operating at the intersection of technology and marketing, we create what is next by pioneering ideas, acting fast, and moving further because standing still just is not in our DNA.

At DEPT®, you will find the freedom to explore, the space to collaborate, and the trust to make a real impact for our clients, for each other, and for the world we are helping to build.

THE ROLE:

We believe that real media impact comes from having a holistic understanding of consumers, culture, channels, content and commerce. Deciphering present day trends and historical performance from these interconnected and interdependent fields begins to represent our journey towards lasting growth for our clients.

As such, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Integrated Media Strategy & Planning who shares this approach and wants to join a talented team of growth marketers. This role is equal parts research and insight development as well as a strategic client partner. This person will join us as a key member of our strategy team; working alongside the directors to provide robust data-based strategies to our clients while also helping to guide larger cross-functional teams on campaign planning and ongoing optimizations.

In this role, you will serve as a trusted advisor for internal cross-functional team members and external partners and become a steward of integrated planning and strategy core practices and solutions, with a particular focus on transforming the way consumers engage and shop across retail marketplaces and direct-to-consumer (D2C) environments.

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

You'll be responsible for:

Planning

  • Developing integrated media plans across D2C and retail marketplace business models, including tactic-level plans and investment scenarios, grounded in strategy, methodology benchmarks, and thoughtful assumptions.
  • Translating research insights into actionable media plans by synthesizing inputs from tools such as GWI, eMarketer, Pathmatics, Similarweb, and client or platform data (Meta, Google, Amazon, The Trade Desk, etc.).
  • Building full-funnel, channel-agnostic media plans using both CPC- and CPM-based investment frameworks.
  • Developing audience-first communication plans, including budget allocation, KPI frameworks, channel selection, and partner recommendations.
  • Aligning campaign planning with product launch calendars, retail media opportunities, and promotional moments across key U.S. retailers.
  • Applying a strong working knowledge of Amazon Ads (search, DSP, display) to support retail and performance-focused planning efforts. Familiarity with Best Buy Ads, Walmart Connect, and Target Roundel is highly valuable, with the ability to adapt plans to evolving retail media capabilities and brand footprints.
  • Maintaining awareness of global retail and go-to-market considerations to inform planning for international expansion and multi-market execution.

Collaboration

  • Serving as a dependable thought partner to strategy leads, helping to operationalize strategic planning frameworks and guide planning through to activation.
  • Working closely with cross-functional team members both externally and internally across Client Services, Media Activation, Data Science, and Creative to deliver connected plans and ensure seamless campaign execution, including tracking plan vs. actuals.
  • Navigating complexity across platforms, stakeholders, and business models, and translating that complexity into clear, actionable plans.
  • Presenting and articulating planning recommendations clearly to both internal and external stakeholders with confidence.
  • Boosting morale and contributing to an inclusive, supportive team culture by being a positive example in group problem solving and growing careers of junior team members.
  • Sharing platform trends, retail innovations, and media shifts with the team to inspire fresh thinking and continuous improvement.

You'll need to have:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in media planning and strategy, with an emphasis on digital media buying both on and off retail environments.
  • 2+ years experience using planning and research tools such as GWI, Pathmatics, Comscore, eMarketer, and platform-native dashboards.
  • 2+ years of client facing and team management experience.
  • Strong familiarity with Amazon’s retail media solutions; knowledge of Best Buy, Target, Walmart, and other retail platforms is a strong plus.
  • Proven experience planning across both CPC and CPM channels, with a clear understanding of brand and performance media and how they work together.
  • Strong understanding of audience segmentation, full-funnel planning, and measurement frameworks.
  • Ability to clearly and concisely articulate a persuasive point of view, both written and verbal, presenting to project stakeholders.
  • A curious and creative mindset, while also rigorous and analytical.
  • Energized by the evolving intersection of media, retail, technology, and consumer behavior.

Job Summary

Role Overview


Palo Alto Networks is seeking an experienced, strategic, and proactive Senior Manager, Public Policy & Government Affairs responsible for Australia and New Zealand, based in Australia, preferably in Sydney or Canberra.

Reporting to the Vice President, JAPAC, you will coordinate with regional and global public policy colleagues to align local engagement with broader business and policy priorities.

Policy Strategy & Advocacy: Design and execute strategic advocacy initiatives across Australia and New Zealand on issues including AI security, supply chain risk management, zero trust, incident reporting, critical infrastructure resilience, and cloud security. Engage with Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand ministries, departments, and agencies.


Government & Parliamentary Engagement: Develop trusted relationships with ministers’ offices, senior public servants, relevant parliamentary committees, and government cybersecurity leaders in both countries. Priority stakeholders will include:

  • Australia: The Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, the Department of Defence, the Department of Industry, Science and Resources, the Digital Transformation Agency, and relevant State and Territory cybersecurity and digital government bodies.

  • Experience within Australian or New Zealand government, a ministerial office, parliamentary committee, or a relevant cybersecurity, national security, or digital government agency is highly alued. Experience working across both markets is desirable.

  • Strong understanding of critical infrastructure security, government security and cloud assurance settings, software supply chain security, and emerging AI policy frameworks.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Public Policy, International Affairs, Political Science, Computer Science, Law, or a related field.
  • Exceptional written, analytical, and verbal communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to synthesise complex technical security topics for non-technical policymakers, senior government officials, and C-suite executives.
  • An established network of trusted relationships across Australian Federal, State and Territory Governments and relevant New Zealand government stakeholders.
  • Strong relationships with the Department of Home Affairs, ASD/ACSC, GCSB/NCSC, relevant parliamentary committees, and cybersecurity, national security, and digital government agencies are particularly valuable.
  • Based in Australia, with Sydney or Canberra preferred, and willing to travel regularly to Canberra, other Australian capitals, and New Zealand, particularly Wellington, for government and stakeholder engagement.

About Avaya

Avaya is an enterprise software leader that helps the world’s largest organizations and government agencies forge unbreakable connections.

The Avaya Infinity™ platform unifies fragmented customer experiences, connecting the channels, insights, technologies, and workflows that together create enduring customer and employee relationships.

We believe success is built through strong connections – with each other, with our work, and with our mission. At Avaya, you'll find a community that values your contributions and supports your growth every step of the way.

Learn more at

The Opportunity

Enterprise software should be as intuitive, engaging, and seamless as the consumer experiences people use every day. At Avaya, we’re bringing that standard to enterprise customer experience by transforming Avaya Infinity into a next-generation Connection Center—one that goes beyond traditional contact center workflows to create more intelligent, connected, and personalized customer interactions.

Our vision is built around three principles: Connections, Context, and Insights. By bringing together real-time data, customer history, and AI-powered capabilities, Avaya Infinity will help organizations deliver more meaningful interactions across web, desktop, mobile, and AI-driven workflows.

We’re looking for a Principal Product Designer – AI & Enterprise UX to help define and bring this vision to life. This is an opportunity to shape the experience of a strategic enterprise platform—not only designing new capabilities, but reimagining existing workflows, modernizing the user experience, and establishing the design systems and standards that will guide the platform forward.

As a senior individual contributor, you’ll operate at the intersection of product strategy, design, and engineering. You’ll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences, use rapid prototyping and AI-enabled design tools to accelerate decision-making, and partner closely with engineering to translate design intent into high-quality products. Your influence will extend beyond individual features to the overall usability, consistency, and evolution of Avaya Infinity.

What You'll Do

  • Shape the Avaya Infinity Experience: Translate the vision for Connections, Context, and Insights into intuitive, human-centered experiences across web, desktop (Windows/Mac), and mobile—raising the bar for enterprise software usability and design.

  • Design New Capabilities and Modernize Existing Experiences: Lead UX and product design for key Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives while identifying and addressing usability gaps, outdated workflows, and inconsistencies across the platform.

  • Accelerate Innovation Through Rapid Prototyping: Use interactive prototypes, AI-enabled design tools, and iterative testing to validate concepts early, clarify requirements, and help engineering teams move from idea to implementation faster.

  • Build Scalable Design Systems and Engineering Workflows: Establish and evolve Figma components, variables, design tokens, and handoff standards in close partnership with engineering. Ensure designs translate effectively into production across React, Electron, and native applications while minimizing rework and improving implementation quality.

  • Design the Next Generation of AI-Powered Experiences: Create intuitive ways to incorporate real-time agent assistance, automated interaction summaries, predictive routing, and generative AI capabilities—making complex information actionable without overwhelming users.

  • Lead UX Strategy Across Product and Engineering: Own the UX roadmap for Avaya Infinity, influence product priorities, and advocate for user-centered design in executive reviews. Partner across Product Management, Solution Architecture, and Engineering to align design decisions with customer needs, technical feasibility, and business outcomes.

What You Bring

  • Enterprise Product Design Experience: Significant experience designing complex B2B software across web, desktop, and mobile platforms. Experience with CCaaS, UCaaS, CRM, or other enterprise SaaS products is highly valued.

  • A Strong UX Portfolio: Demonstrated ability to transform complex workflows and information-dense interfaces into intuitive, modern experiences. Your portfolio shows how you balance usability, visual design, and business requirements to simplify the user experience.

  • Strategic Thinking and Hands-On Execution: Ability to move seamlessly between defining a long-term UX vision and delivering high-quality designs for immediate product priorities. You know how to modernize existing experiences while building a foundation for future capabilities.

  • Advanced Figma and Design Systems Expertise: Strong command of Figma, including variables, design tokens, component libraries, auto-layout, and reusable design patterns. Experience establishing scalable design systems and integrating design workflows with frontend development is essential.

  • Rapid Prototyping and AI-Enabled Design: Experience using interactive prototyping, iterative testing, and emerging AI-powered design tools to validate concepts quickly, resolve ambiguity, and accelerate product development.

  • Close Collaboration with Engineering: Proven ability to partner with frontend engineers to evaluate technical feasibility, communicate design intent, and deliver implementation-ready specifications across modern web, desktop, and native applications.

  • Product and Customer Experience Acumen: Understanding of complex customer interaction workflows, omnichannel experiences, real-time data, and analytics. You connect design decisions to customer needs, product strategy, and measurable business outcomes.

  • Accessibility and Inclusive Design: Strong understanding of accessibility standards, including WCAG, and experience incorporating inclusive design principles into complex enterprise applications from the outset.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences, including real-time agent assistance, contextual recommendations, automated summaries, or generative AI workflows.

  • Familiarity with React, Electron, native application architectures, and design-to-code workflows.

  • Experience leading design strategy and influencing product and engineering decisions as a senior individual contributor in a cross-functional environment.

How Success Is Measured

  • Design Delivery and Engineering Velocity: Deliver high-quality, implementation-ready designs for Avaya Infinity roadmap initiatives on schedule. Use rapid prototyping, clear specifications, and close engineering collaboration to target a 25–30% improvement in design-to-code velocity.

  • Platform Modernization and UX Improvement: Evaluate existing Infinity experiences, identify the highest-impact usability challenges, and establish a prioritized UX improvement roadmap. Reduce friction in legacy workflows while improving consistency, usability, and scalability across the platform.

  • Design System Adoption and Handoff Quality: Establish consistent Figma components, design tokens, and design-to-code workflows across web, desktop, and mobile. Reduce ambiguity, minimize developer rework, and improve the fidelity of implemented designs.

  • Measurable User Experience Impact: Improve usability through measurable reductions in cognitive load, unnecessary interaction steps, and task completion time. Track progress through usability testing, System Usability Scale (SUS) scores, and agent satisfaction (Agent CSAT), where applicable.

Why Join Avaya?

At Avaya, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of enterprise customer experience—not simply refine existing interfaces. You’ll help transform Avaya Infinity into a modern, AI-enabled Connection Center that brings together Connections, Context, and Insights to make customer interactions more intuitive, intelligent, and meaningful.

This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you can influence product strategy, establish the UX direction for a strategic platform, and see your work move from concept to production. You’ll combine creative ownership and hands-on design with close collaboration across Product Management, Architecture, and Engineering.

If you’re energized by simplifying complex technology, challenging legacy design conventions, and using emerging AI capabilities to create better user experiences, Avaya offers the opportunity to make a meaningful impact on software that supports customer interactions around the world.

The pay range for this opportunity is up to $187,800 in total compensation, inclusive of base salary and bonus. Actual total compensation will vary based on factors such as a candidate’s qualifications, skills, competencies, and relevant experience.

Experience

5 - 8 Years of Experience

Education

Bachelor degree or equivalent experience

Footer

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

We have a fantastic opportunity for a Learning and Development Business Partner, to join our Senior Leadership Team. This role will be remote with national travel.

Reporting directly to the Group Chief People Officer you will strengthen management capability and team effectiveness across EMED Group through practical, accessible learning. Working in partnership with operational leaders and People colleagues, deliver Management Acceleration Pathway (MAP) modules, bespoke local training and Insights-based development, while expanding and maintaining the online learning library.

This hands-on national role translates business and team development needs into learning that managers can apply every day, supporting consistent management practice, operational effectiveness and patient-centred service delivery.

Benefits for the role include

  • Competitive Salary
  • Annual car allowance
  • Performance related bonus
  • Private Healthcare
  • 33 days annual leave (inclusive of bank holidays) with the option to purchase additional leave through salary sacrifice.
  • Life Assurance
  • 24/7 online/telephone GP Consultation and access to prescriptions.
  • 2nd opinion medical support following diagnosis or where a colleague is on a treatment pathway.
  • Cash-plan benefits, providing colleagues the option of protecting themselves in case of illness and recuperation, including dental, optical, chiropody.
  • Access to mental health and physiotherapy consultations.
  • Access to legal advice on domestic issues e.g. motoring offences, wills and probate, and personal injury.
  • Long Service Recognition Scheme – recognising colleagues for their continued service after 5 years and at 5-year intervals with an increase in annual leave.

Role Responsibilities

  • Plan, coordinate and deliver MAP modules nationally through face-to-face workshops, virtual sessions and blended learning.
  • Build managers’ practical skills in communication, coaching, constructive feedback, delegation, team development, managing change and everyday management conversations.
  • Tailor examples, exercises and resources to operational settings while maintaining agreed MAP learning outcomes and delivery standards.
  • Work with HR team and subject matter experts to keep management content accurate, relevant and aligned with organisational policies and priorities.
  • Partner with operational leaders and HR Business Partners to understand local priorities and identify management and team development needs.
  • Design and deliver bespoke workshops, team development days and targeted training, adapting relevant MAP modules to meet local needs.
  • Support teams to strengthen communication, collaboration, clarity of responsibilities and shared ownership of agreed actions.
  • Promote MAP, team development and online learning through clear communications that explain the benefits and encourage participation.
  • Equip managers to deliver effective team briefings, listening conversations and communication during change through targeted training and practical resources.
  • Coordinate and deliver Insights-based development sessions in accordance with the chosen tool’s requirements and applicable practitioner accreditation.
  • Help managers and colleagues understand working preferences, adapt communication and collaborate effectively, without labelling people or making assumptions about capability.
  • Support teams to agree practical actions and revisit progress after sessions.
  • Maintain a prioritised development plan for new online modules, informed by management learning needs, recurring local requirements and organisational priorities.
  • Design and build engaging digital modules with clear learning objectives, practical scenarios, knowledge checks and supporting resources.
  • Use evaluation findings to improve programmes and inform priorities, distinguishing the contribution of learning from other factors affecting operational outcomes.

Do you have what it takes?

  • Experience designing and delivering management development and team learning in a multi-site or geographically dispersed organisation.
  • Strong facilitation skills, with the ability to engage different audiences through face-to-face and virtual delivery.
  • Ability to identify learning needs with stakeholders and translate them into practical, proportionate development solutions.
  • Experience creating digital learning modules using authoring tools and working with learning management systems.
  • Understanding of adult learning, blended learning and methods for evaluating learning application.
  • Clear written and verbal communication, strong stakeholder relationships and the confidence to influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to manage a national delivery schedule alongside bespoke requests and content development deadlines.
  • Commitment to accessible learning, confidentiality, respectful working relationships and patient-centred service delivery.
  • Ability to meet the national travel requirements of the role.

Desirable experience and qualifications

  • Relevant learning and development, training, coaching or organisational development qualification, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Accreditation in the Insights tool used by the organisation, or willingness to complete the required accreditation before independent delivery.
  • Experience supporting healthcare, patient transport, logistics or other operational, shift-based services.
  • Experience linking engagement feedback with team development and management learning.

About Us

EMED Group is an established healthcare logistics provider that enables access to health and social care through our four specialist divisions. We are one of the largest health and care partners to the NHS with 4,000 colleagues across over 60 bases UK-wide.

EMED Group is committed to pro-actively improving the wellbeing of our communities by providing access to vital health and social care services across the UK.

Job Overview

At Relativity, we build technology that helps people uncover the truth in complex data. Our software (SaaS) empowers legal professionals, governments, and organizations around the world to navigate high stakes matters with confidence, clarity, and integrity. By combining advanced AI, powerful analytics, and cloud-based technology, we help teams make sense of massive volumes of information and move critical work forward faster and more accurately. Every role at Relativity contributes to creating scalable, secure, and intelligent solutions with real-world impact—while fostering a culture where curiosity, collaboration, and inclusion thrive and where employees help shape the future of legal technology. 

Department Description:

The AI and Applied Sciences department at Relativity drives innovation by developing advanced AI solutions and applied research to solve complex legal and compliance challenges.

Job Summary:

The Legal Data Intelligence SME will bring expertise as a practicing litigator and deep knowledge of discovery. You’ll draw on this expertise to help us build and evaluate our key generative AI capabilities. You’ll interface with other litigators, both helping us explain how our technology operates to them and taking their feedback and providing it back to our applied science team, conveying the nuances of both the technology and the needs of the litigator persona as you do so. This role bridges legal expertise with technical innovation, guiding the design and deployment of solutions that optimize data intelligence for legal workflows.

  • Work externally with our clients and our industry to explain how our generative AI systems work and to receive their feedback on the performance of our generative AI in analyzing and classifying documents, identifying information that needs to be protected, and extracting and curating knowledge.
  • Develop and deliver training and documentation for internal teams on legal data intelligence workflows and best practices.

  • Strong and clear communicator, able to synthesize and communicate complex technical concepts and results to internal and external audiences.
  • Experience in discovery or legal technology platforms.
  • Experience working with cross-functional teams.

Preferred Qualifications :

  • Significant litigation experience and deep understanding of the processes of investigations and litigation, including discovery and pre-trial practice
  • At least 5 years of experience as a practicing attorney
  • Strong understanding of the traditional EDRM and broader Legal Data Intelligence use cases and workflows.

Suggested Skills:

Business Intelligence (BI), Data Analysis, Data Governance, Data Intelligence, Data Visualization, Information Security, Legal Practices, Legal Research, Risk Management, Structured Query Language (SQL)

See your work in a new light.

At LUX Infusion, we’re reimagining infusion care to be more human, supportive, and connected. Inspired by lux—meaning light - we guide patients, providers, and partners through complex therapies with clarity, compassion, and confidence.

As a clinician-led, U.S.-based organization, we put people first - helping patients feel seen and supported through faster therapy starts, dedicated care coordination, and meaningful collaboration. Our commitment to inclusion, diversity, equity, and advancement (IDEA) is central to our culture, ensuring every team member feels valued and empowered to make a difference.

We’re looking for a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy who wants their work to mean something—someone who brings care, accountability, and purpose to what they do every day.

Schedule & Location

Location: Overland Park, KS, or Plantation, FL or Remote

Schedule:

  • Monday - Friday, 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Why This Role Matters

As a Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy, you play a critical role in ensuring patients receive safe, effective, and timely specialty infusion therapies. Your expertise helps guide medication management, support clinical decision-making, and ensure every prescription is reviewed with accuracy and care.

In this role, you’ll contribute to work that:

  • Helps patients feel informed, supported, and confident throughout their treatment journey
  • Ensures safe and compliant specialty pharmacy operations
  • Supports clinicians, providers, and care teams through clinical expertise and collaboration
  • Advances positive patient outcomes through thoughtful medication management and oversight

Everything we do connects back to real people navigating complex healthcare journeys—and this role helps make that journey brighter.

What You'll Do

The Director, Talent Acquisition Strategy leads the development and execution of LUX Infusion's enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy. This role is responsible for building a scalable, data-driven recruiting function that anticipates workforce needs and supports clinical, operational, professional, and leadership hiring across multiple states and markets.

The Director partners closely with executive leadership, Human Resources, Finance, Operations, and hiring leaders to translate business plans into workforce strategies; strengthen the employer brand and talent pipelines; optimize recruiting and onboarding processes; and use meaningful KPIs and analytics to improve hiring outcomes. The ideal candidate is a strategic, hands-on leader who can build systems, influence stakeholders, and operate effectively in a fast-paced, growing organization. Success in this role requires the ability to connect enterprise strategy with disciplined execution, create transparency through reliable data, and build a recruiting function that consistently delivers talent needed for growth.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Talent Acquisition Strategy and Workforce Planning
• Develop and execute an enterprise-wide talent acquisition strategy aligned with LUX Infusion's growth plans, operating priorities, and long-term workforce needs.
• Partner with Finance, Operations, Human Resources, and business leaders to translate growth projections, turnover trends, labor availability, and productivity expectations into short- and long-term workforce plans.
• Create hiring forecasts, capacity models, prioritization frameworks, and recruiting resource plans that improve organizational readiness and reduce reactive hiring.
• Advise executive leadership on talent availability, geographic labor-market conditions, hiring risks, recruiting investments, and workforce implications of business decisions.
• Establish consistent, equitable, and legally compliant standards for job intake, candidate evaluation, interviewing, selection, and hiring decisions nationwide.
• Support workforce planning and talent acquisition needs for acquisitions, integrations, and new-market expansion as a recurring, core component of this role, not an incidental one.

Sourcing, Pipeline Development, and Employer Brand
• Build sustainable talent pipelines for critical, recurring, and difficult-to-fill positions across clinical, operational, professional, and leadership functions.
• Develop data-driven sourcing strategies using labor-market intelligence, geographic analysis, candidate and conversion data, referrals, professional networks, educational partnerships, and digital channels.
• Measure source quality and channel effectiveness to focus recruiting resources on approaches that produce qualified, durable hires drawn from broad candidate pools.
• Develop and maintain a compelling employer value proposition and partner with Marketing and Communications to strengthen the LUX Infusion employment brand.
• Create strategies for passive-candidate engagement, talent-community management, and market-specific outreach within a consistent national framework.

Recruiting Operations, Technology, and Onboarding
• Evaluate and optimize the end-to-end recruiting process, including requisition approval, sourcing, screening, interviewing, selection, offers, pre-employment requirements, and transition to onboarding.
• Establish recruiting service levels, standardized workflows, clear decision rights, and accountability for recruiters, hiring managers, and business partners.
• Lead the effective use and ongoing optimization of the applicant tracking system, including Greenhouse configuration, workflows, data integrity, reporting, user adoption, and compliance.
• Evaluate recruiting technology and automation opportunities that improve scheduling, candidate engagement, analytics, reporting, and team productivity, and confirm that any automated or AI-assisted screening tools comply with applicable law.
• Partner with Human Resources, IT, Compliance, and Operations to create a coordinated preboarding and onboarding experience, including licensure and credential verification and federal exclusion screening where applicable, that reduces delays and pre-start attrition and accelerates new-hire readiness.
• Use candidate and new-hire feedback to continuously improve the candidate, preboarding, and onboarding experience.

Analytics, KPIs, and Continuous Improvement
• Develop and maintain a comprehensive talent acquisition measurement framework, including KPIs, dashboards, targets, benchmarks, and reporting standards.
• Track and analyze measures such as hiring-plan attainment, time to fill, time to hire, cost per hire, source effectiveness, pipeline conversion, offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, recruiter productivity, quality of hire, early retention, and stakeholder satisfaction.
• Conduct regular business reviews with leadership to assess performance, forecast needs, identify risks, and recommend corrective actions or resource changes.
• Ensure data integrity and disciplined system use so recruiting analytics are accurate, timely, consistent, and actionable.
• Develop leading and predictive indicators that allow the organization to anticipate hiring challenges rather than react after vacancies affect operations.

Leadership, Partnership, and Compensation Review
• Lead, coach, and develop the talent acquisition team, establishing clear expectations, performance standards, operating rhythms, and accountability.
• Serve as a strategic advisor to hiring leaders and provide training, tools, and guidance that improve interview quality, decision-making, and candidate engagement.
• Partner with Human Resources and Finance to evaluate compensation competitiveness using market data, internal equity, candidate feedback, offer outcomes, and hiring performance.
• Recommend adjustments to compensation ranges, geographic differentials, hiring incentives, or offer practices when supported by market and performance data.
• Assess when external search firms, agencies, contract recruiters, or other resources are warranted and manage those relationships and investments effectively.
• Manage recruiting spend within the approved annual budget.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS & RESPONSIBILITIES
• Represent LUX Infusion at recruiting events, professional conferences, educational programs, and community partnerships, as appropriate.
• Support enterprise projects and special workforce initiatives as requested.
• Maintain professional knowledge of recruiting practices, labor-market trends, technology, and applicable employment laws.
• Participate in quality assurance, compliance, and process audits as directed.
• Perform other related duties as assigned.

What We're Looking For

QUALIFICATION REQUIREMENTS

• Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Organizational Development, Analytics, or equivalent experience in a related field.
• Minimum of 10 years of progressive talent acquisition or human resources experience, including at least 5 years in a leadership or enterprise recruiting role.
• Demonstrated experience developing and executing talent acquisition strategies across multiple states or on a national scale.
• Strong background in workforce planning, recruiting analytics, dashboard development, and the design and implementation of KPIs.
• Proven ability to analyze recruiting data, identify trends and operational risks, and translate findings into clear recommendations for senior leadership.
• Experience building proactive pipelines and sourcing strategies for high-volume, specialized, clinical, professional, and leadership positions.
• Demonstrated success improving recruiting processes, technology, candidate experience, and hiring-manager effectiveness.
• Demonstrated knowledge of compensation benchmarking, market analysis, internal equity considerations, and offer strategy.
• Knowledge of federal, state, and local laws and regulations applicable to recruiting and hiring across multiple jurisdictions, including pay transparency, fair-chance and background check, salary history, and automated employment decision tool requirements.
• Strong executive communication, stakeholder-management, project-management, and team-leadership skills.

QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED
• Experience administering or materially optimizing Greenhouse ATS.
• Experience supporting healthcare, infusion, specialty pharmacy, or another highly regulated and competitive labor environment.
• Experience in a rapidly growing, geographically dispersed, or private equity-backed organization.
• Experience supporting acquisitions, new-market expansion, organizational integration, or high-volume growth initiatives.
• Advanced degree or professional certification in Human Resources, talent acquisition, analytics, or a related discipline.

CORE COMPETENCIES

• Enterprise and strategic thinking

• Attention to detail

• Workforce planning and business acumen
• KPI development and analytical judgment
• Talent pipeline and sourcing strategy
• Process design and continuous improvement
• Executive communication and influence
• Team leadership and talent development
• Cross-functional collaboration
• Change management and operational discipline
• Professionalism, integrity, and sound judgment

Performance Measures
• Achievement of approved hiring plans and critical-role staffing priorities.
• Time to fill, time to hire, and vacancy aging by role, market, and business unit.
• Pipeline health, source effectiveness, funnel conversion, and qualified-candidate flow.
• Offer acceptance, candidate withdrawal, and pre-start attrition rates.
• Quality of hire and new-hire retention.
• Recruiter productivity, process compliance, and data integrity.
• Hiring manager and candidate satisfaction.
• Effectiveness of recruiting investments, including cost per hire and agency utilization.

Communication Skills
• Communicates clearly, persuasively, and appropriately with executives, hiring leaders, candidates, and team members; listens and seeks clarification; presents complex workforce and recruiting data in an accessible manner; and prepares concise, accurate written communications and executive-level reports.

Computer Skills
• Advanced proficiency with applicant tracking systems, reporting and dashboard tools, Microsoft Excel, and Microsoft Office applications.

You don’t need to check every box—we care just as much about how you show up as what’s on your resume.

Why LUX Infusion

At LUX Infusion, we believe infusion care deserves more light—more warmth, more clarity, and more connection.

Here, you’ll find:

  • Purpose-driven work with real impact
  • A patient-first, clinician-led culture
  • Supportive, collaborative teammates
  • Opportunities to expand your clinical expertise and professional growth
  • The chance to help shape the future of specialty infusion care

Come help us elevate infusion care—and see what’s possible when care comes first.

Pay Range/Rate
$145,000—$160,000 USD

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here represent those required for an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these functions. If you require a reasonable accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact the LUX Infusion Talent Team at or 954.385.7322 x 1425.

While performing the duties of this position, the employee may occasionally be required to stand, walk, or sit; use hands to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and talk or hear. The employee may also be required to occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this role include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

OTHER REQUIREMENTS

Employees are expected to:

  • Participate annually in required legal and ethical compliance training
  • Consistently act in compliance with LUX Infusion’s legal, ethical, and compliance policies
  • Adhere to all standards and procedures outlined in the LUX Infusion Compliance Manual
  • Refrain from any behavior that could be considered unethical or unlawful

EXPECTATIONS FOR ALL EMPLOYEES

All LUX Infusion team members are expected to support the organization’s mission, vision, and values by demonstrating integrity, dedication, compassion, and enthusiasm. This includes placing patients first, working collaboratively with a “stacked‑hands” mindset, and maintaining a consistent focus on quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

GENERAL INFORMATION

The statements above are intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed by individuals in this role. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, or skills required.

This role operates in a fast‑paced environment and requires the ability to prioritize competing demands, manage multiple tasks effectively, and seek guidance when appropriate.

Employees in this position may be required to assist directly - or coordinate appropriate assistance - to ensure access to LUX Infusion’s services for individuals with disabilities, including patients, visitors, employees, or others.

LUX Infusion is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

As Business Development Manager Data Centers, you drive business growth through strong account management, strategic sales initiatives, and technical-commercial insight.   • Join a dedicated team that works closely together, with a positive attitude and a strong can-do mentality.
  • Enjoy working in an international environment, with colleagues and customers from different countries and cultures.
  • Grow in a thriving and financially strong company that offers continuous learning, along with a competitive salary package, including various benefits.

Are you a high-performing sales professional with a chemical background, or a strong affinity with chemistry? Do you enjoy developing new business, building customer relationships and working closely with an international team? Do you want to be at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing infrastructure industries and help shape our success in Europe?
